title: Which different county has the most number of closed schools? Please provid
question:
Which different county has the most number of closed schools? Please provide the name of each school as well as the closure date.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Closure date and closed date are synonyms; 'Closed' was mentioned in schools.StatusType.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_045 AS county, s.XCL_047 AS school_name, s.XCL_062 AS closure_date
FROM schools s
WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
  AND s.XCL_045 = (
    SELECT s2.XCL_045
    FROM schools s2
    WHERE s2.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s2.XCL_045
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY s.XCL_062;
